recipe.visualDefinition: A dimly lit, atmospheric 3D rendering of a bank vault interior, featuring a large stack of US hundred-dollar bills and a pyramid of credit cards resting on a polished black marble plinth. A single spotlight illuminates the money, creating a dramatic contrast with the surrounding shadows and mist.
coreVisualRelationships: The stack of money is centrally positioned and illuminated, drawing immediate attention.
The credit cards form a base for the money, suggesting a hierarchy of financial instruments.
The vault door and mechanism provide a secure, imposing backdrop.
The spotlight creates a strong focal point and emphasizes the texture of the money and marble.
coreInvariants: The scene is set inside a bank vault with a prominent, closed vault door.
A large stack of US hundred-dollar bills is present.
A stack of credit cards is positioned beneath the money.
The objects rest on a dark, polished marble surface.
Dramatic lighting from above highlights the central objects.
Atmospheric mist or fog is present in the vault.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The stack of money and credit cards are centrally located in the lower-middle section of the frame, occupying approximately 20% of the vertical space and 30% of the horizontal space. The vault door fills the background, providing context and scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit stack of hundred-dollar bills serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is immediately drawn to the illuminated money, then moves down to the credit cards, and subsequently explores the details of the vault door and its mechanisms in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed areas of the vault and the mist-filled atmosphere create significant negative space around the central illuminated objects, enhancing their prominence.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark grays and bronzes (vault, shadows) provide a rich, secure, and somewhat ominous background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The bright green and white of the US currency, along with the subtle blues and purples of the credit cards, provide a strong contrast against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The golden hues of the vault mechanism and the warm glow of the spotlight act as metallic accents, suggesting value and strength.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The central objects (money, cards) are highly saturated and brightly lit, standing out against the low-saturation, dark, and desaturated background elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to metallic tones (gold, bronze, steel), dark marble, and the specific colors of US currency and credit cards.
Avoid overly bright or pastel colors outside of the central illuminated area.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A sans-serif typeface with medium weight and normal width.
letterConstructionRules: Letters have a consistent stroke width.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on top of the image, outside the main scene

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The single text element is simple and functional, designed not to compete with the main visual.
graphicDevices: A black rectangular box containing the text, providing a clear background for readability.

candidateDirections.reason: Clear, legible sans-serif with good readability at small sizes.
Modern, versatile sans-serif with a neutral aesthetic.
Geometric sans-serif that offers a clean and contemporary feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Render the full vault scene with the money, credit cards, marble plinth, and atmospheric effects. Ensure the bottom right corner is clear for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black rectangular box in the bottom right corner. Inside this box, place the white, uppercase sans-serif text aligned to the left, with normal tracking and leading.

verificationChecks: Is the text clearly legible against its background?
Does the text occupy the bottom right corner without obstructing key visual elements?
Is the font a clean, simple sans-serif?
Is the text color white and case uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Exact amount of money in the stack (maintain large volume)
Specific credit card designs (maintain stack and general appearance)
Intensity and spread of the spotlight
Density and distribution of the atmospheric mist
Subtle variations in the metallic sheen of the vault

mustAchieve: A sense of opulence and security.
Dramatic lighting that highlights the central objects.
Realistic rendering of materials (metal, marble, paper currency).

postGenerationChecks: Verify the central stack of money and cards is the brightest element.
Confirm the vault environment appears secure and imposing.
Check for realistic reflections and refractions on the marble and metal surfaces.
Ensure the atmospheric mist adds depth without obscuring key details.
Confirm the overall mood is one of wealth and security.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a bank vault interior with a dark, metallic aesthetic. Place a polished black marble plinth centrally. On the plinth, stack a large amount of US hundred-dollar bills, and beneath them, a smaller stack of credit cards. Illuminate these objects with a strong, overhead spotlight, casting dramatic shadows. Add atmospheric mist or fog to enhance depth and mood. Ensure the vault door and its mechanisms are visible in the background.
